long_biography.plain_text:
Macpherson entered the family oil business by working on drilling rigs and managing field operations in Bakersfield. His father had founded the company as an independent producer, and the younger Macpherson became its owner, president and chief executive. He also represented California's independent petroleum industry in national policy discussions.

The family company's core producing assets were eventually acquired by another operator after decades under his leadership. His energy work also included power-generation partnerships and renewable biomass. Beyond business, Macpherson has sustained a public competitive-sailing career, campaigning internationally and winning a leading offshore regatta.
